ideas.children_he: הָרָשָׁע אֵינוֹ מְכַבֵּד אֶת ה׳, מַטְעֶה אֶת עַצְמוֹ וּבוֹחֵר בְּשֶׁקֶר וּבְרָעָה.
ideas.children_en: The wicked person has no respect for God, deceives himself, and chooses lies and wrongdoing.

ideas.children_he: חֶסֶד ה׳ גָּדוֹל כַּשָּׁמַיִם, וּבְקִרְבָתוֹ בְּנֵי אָדָם מוֹצְאִים מַחֲסֶה, חַיִּים וְאוֹר.
ideas.children_en: God's kindness is as great as the heavens; close to Him, people find shelter, life, and light.

ideas.children_he: הַמְשׁוֹרֵר מְבַקֵּשׁ חֶסֶד לַיְשָׁרִים וַהֲגָנָה מִגַּאֲוָה וּמֵרְשָׁעִים.
ideas.children_en: The psalmist asks kindness for the upright and protection from pride and wicked people.
